title: ヒーロー＆ヒロイン映画の秋！

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! The Justice All-Stars vs the Villain Squad is finally out!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My heart's fluttering with excitement! ♪ Carrot Ranger, Princess Fighter… All the best heroes teamed up for justice! This is going to be a classic.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh, did you guys even watch the trailer? The villains are pretty strong this time around!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wh-what did you say?! Carrot Ranger will never give up, no matter who the villain is!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You sure about that? 'Cause the heroes got knocked right off their feet in the trailer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sorry to burst your bubble, but the bad guys are winning today!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: …Ugh, dang it! The bad guys were so close…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh dear… There's no need for all those tears.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm not crying!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Being an ally of justice, I would never support the forces of evil, but…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I know where you're going. I feel for Windy too. If Princess Fighter ever lost, I'd be a sobbing mess.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Graaaah! Enough already! I don't need your pity!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: My only option is to lash out! I'll spoil the movie for everyone who hasn't seen it yet!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're going to what?! Not on my watch!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: As a princess, I cannot overlook this. I'll use every last drop of my princess power to stop you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hah! You can't scare me! I'm spoiling the story, and you'll never change my mind!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Are you so sure of that?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If you spoil it for everyone, you'll ruin the climax when King Bad Guy makes his comeback!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The moment his tragic past is revealed, and in the end when he protects his allies and takes the final blow… It's so admirable for a bad guy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! He might've been the bad guy, but his story was super moving! And you want to take that experience away?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-no, I'd never! I want everyone to know how cool King Bad Guy is!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Okay… I won't spoil anything. Everyone's gotta have the full experience!
